title: Workday Release and Adoption Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Workday Release and Adoption Manager is responsible for managing the technical and organizational aspects of Workday releases, driving user adoption, and supporting continuous improvement of Workday functionality across the organization. This role serves as the central point of coordination for release management, change communication, training and support, regression testing, and operational governance. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, deep Workday expertise, and a passion for driving organizational excellence through effective systems management and user enablement.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday release management and feature adoption. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional area requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Workday Community and Functional Area Self‑Service Support – Support organizational capability building and issue resolution
    • Manage Community user access and profiles
      • Work with HR and ETS to deactivate users no longer employed with the organization
      • Connect users to appropriate Community resources and documentation
    • Support submission of ideas to Ideation Hub to encourage Workday product development and new functionality
    • Support cross‑functional teams in continuous improvement efforts
    • Identify problems from recurrent issues and lead resolution efforts by coordinating resources
    • Oversee and manage escalated issue resolution
      • Manage Workday Support Cases and Ask‑an‑Expert tickets
      • Escalate issues as needed to ensure resolution
      • Ensure functional area operational continuity
  • Manage incidents and service requests
    • Report on and elevate tickets across all systems (Workday Help Cases, Request Framework, Security Requests, ServiceNow, other tools)
    • Ensure timely tracking and resolution
    • Generate and manage updates to Workday Help Articles for accuracy and relevance
  • Tenant Management – Manage non‑production Workday environments
    • Manage refresh schedules, refresh requests, and coordinate tenant refreshes for non‑production tenants
    • Maintain activity logs for each tenant
    • Communicate tenant refresh schedules and impacts to stakeholders
  • Releases and Regression Testing – Lead Workday release management and testing coordination
    • Log and disseminate all relevant weekly release notes and manage bi‑annual releases utilizing tools in Community, Adoption Planning, and Kainos SmartTest
    • Work with functional areas to ensure awareness of release information, including:
      • Release item notes and documentation
      • Testing coordination (responsibilities, timeframes, tenant refreshes)
      • Workday Support Case resolution and completion tracking
    • Support functional area learning of new functionality by connecting them with Workday Community resources
    • Support functional areas in regression and configuration testing of new functionality being implemented
      • Test planning, scenario development, and execution
      • Issue log management and resolution tracking
      • Completion verification and sign‑off
      • Research and champion new and emerging Workday functionality
      • Perform basic report writing and collaborate with report writers to identify exceptions and testing requirements
    • Operational Meetings and Support – Maintain operational governance and cross‑functional coordination
      • Build and maintain strong relationships with all functional area stakeholders
      • Meet regularly with operational areas to address issues and concerns
      • Prepare meeting agendas, materials, and action item tracking
      • Disseminate release updates and technical information that may impact operations
      • Support feature adoption
        • Assist with planning, scheduling, and coordination
        • Support status tracking and reporting
        • Coordinate cross‑functional engagement to manage feature impacts
        • Monitor effective and timely delivery
        • Identify and escape risks and issues
    • Change Log Management – Maintain comprehensive records of Workday changes
      • Document configuration changes and enhancements
      • Maintain change logs with implementation dates and responsible parties
      • Track configuration versions across all tenants
      • Communicate change history to stakeholders and functional area leads
      • Support audit and compliance reporting on system changes
    • Training and Support – Facilitate user enablement and continuous learning
      • Provide references to Workday Community Resources, such as user guides, quick reference materials, and training videos, for new and enhanced functionality
      • Manage Adoption Planning in Workday and collaborate with business units on release and feature adoption

    Core Competencies

    • Excellent communication skills and ability to build and maintain strong relationships; ability to convey complex technical information to non‑technical audiences
    • Possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail and ability to document
    • Passion for continuous improvement and proactive problem‑solving and ability to manage complex change processes
    • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, accurately collect information, assess situations, and then translate them into technical requirements
    • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
    • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in identifying helpful solutions and driving cross‑functional alignment
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
    • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
    • Minimum 3 years of professional Workday experience with demonstrated expertise in system administration and best practices
    • Experience managing multiple bi‑annual or more frequent release cycles
    • Experience with change management and organizational adoption strategies
    • Proven ability to adhere to and promote Workday best practice methodologies across the organization
    • Basic report writing capabilities in Workday; ability to develop and modify standard reports
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Office productivity suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
    • Strong knowledge of Workday release and tenant management processes
    • Deep familiarity with Workday Community resources, including Workday Success Plans and self‑service materials
    • Knowledge of Workday Help – Cases and Articles functionality
    • Familiarity with ITSM tools and ticketing systems (ServiceNow or similar)

    Expected Salary Range: $85,000 - $100,000

title: Software Engineer - Cloud Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Especialista em Design de Calçados
description:
O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.

II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.

III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
  • Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Software Engineer II, Backend
description:
About The Role

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. In our Brazil Tech Center, you will be joining the engine behind either our Delivery or Mobility Orgs. You won't just be writing code; you will be taking ownership of critical components and features that determine how millions of people and products move globally every single day. You will make smart engineering decisions, design modular components, and own your solutions within your scope. Whether you are optimizing logistics for Delivery or scaling the core trip flow for the Rider App, you will be solving high-impact problems.

What You'll Do

  • Own the design and implementation of high-impact backend components and features, ensuring they are modular, scalable, and efficient.
  • Deliver feature-level technical solutions independently across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Tackle complex problems with multiple dependencies, making sound technical tradeoffs at the feature level.
  • Write robust, efficient, and easily maintainable code while championing best practices like rigorous testing and code health.
  • Proactively identify, isolate, and resolve issues in production. Follow a structured approach to debugging and establishing monitoring for your components.
  • Actively participate in team-level architectural discussions. Partner with cross-functional peers (Product, Operations, Design) to translate requirements into technical deliverables.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of solid experience acting independently across the full software development lifecycle for backend features.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language (e.g., Golang, Java, C++, Python) and openness to learn our stack.
  • Strong foundation in computer science, including algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience writing comprehensive test cases and considering critical edge cases before deployment.
  • Understanding of modular component design and basic system trade-offs (e.g., latency vs. throughput, database selection like SQL vs. NoSQL).
  • Experience participating in constructive code and design reviews, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to identifying and reducing technical debt.
  • English proficiency for effective global collaboration and documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and operating highly concurrent, distributed systems at scale.
  • Experience collaborating with international stakeholders or distributed teams.
  • Proven resilience and adaptability when working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and ambiguity.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area‑related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross‑functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range

$110,000 - $125,000

Descrição da Vaga

Realiza patrulhamento preventivo, tanto interno quanto externo, nas dependências da empresa, com o objetivo de garantir a segurança de colaboradores, visitantes e do patrimônio da organização. Durante as rondas, é responsável por identificar comportamentos suspeitos e agir de forma preventiva para evitar furtos, danos materiais ou outras situações que representem risco à integridade do ambiente.

É responsável pelo controle de acesso de pessoas e veículos, verificando documentação, autorizando apenas o ingresso de indivíduos previamente identificados e garantindo que os procedimentos de entrada e saída sejam cumpridos de forma segura e organizada. Em situações de emergência, atua com agilidade, prestando os primeiros socorros quando necessário e acionando os órgãos competentes, como polícia, bombeiros ou atendimento médico.

Além disso, realiza o registro de ocorrências e incidentes em relatórios diários, detalhando as ações tomadas, horários, envolvidos e demais informações relevantes para o histórico e acompanhamento da segurança da empresa. Por fim, zela pelo cumprimento rigoroso de todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança estabelecidos, assegurando a ordem, o bom funcionamento das operações e a integridade do ambiente corporativo.

Requisitos da Vaga

  • Ensino médio completo (obrigatório).
  • Experiência anterior em áreas de segurança será um diferencial, porém não obrigatória.
  • ATA atualizada (exigida).

  • Boa comunicação, tanto com colegas quanto com visitantes.
  • Conhecimento básico em segurança patrimonial e manuseio de sistemas de segurança e comunicação.
  • Postura proativa e vigilante.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releasees and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross-functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow-up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

Banco de Talentos Diversos - Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência

Rio de Janeiro; São Paulo

VTEX é a plataforma de comércio completa que proporciona mais eficiência e menos manutenção para organizações que buscam fazer investimentos mais inteligentes em TI e modernizar sua estrutura de tecnologia. Através da nossa abordagem pragmática, capacitamos marcas, distribuidores e varejistas com uma flexibilidade incomparável e soluções abrangentes, permitindo que invistam apenas no que oferece uma vantagem clara para o negócio e aumenta a lucratividade.

A VTEX é confiada por 2.400 clientes globais B2C e B2B, incluindo Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker e Whirlpool, operando 3.400 lojas online ativas em 43 países (dados do ano fiscal encerrado em 31 de dezembro de 2024).

Fundada no ano 2000, a VTEX tem uma trajetória de crescimento imbatível. Desafiando todas as probabilidades, estamos liderando a indústria de alta tecnologia e nos posicionando acima de gigantes do mercado. Estamos construindo um futuro extraordinário com mais de 1.300 colaboradores distribuídos por 25 localidades em 16 países da América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia. Para mais informações, visite

Na VTEX, você trabalhará em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, colaborando com colegas incríveis. Se você tem força individual, junte-se a nós e, juntos, seremos imparáveis.

INCLUSÃO E ACESSIBILIDADE

Na VTEX, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que a inclusão é essencial para o nosso sucesso. Esta vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) como parte do nosso compromisso em promover um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo. Acreditamos na geração de oportunidades como ferramenta de mudança e estamos focados em encontrar talentos diversos para nossos times! Estamos comprometidos em adaptar nossas instalações e ferramentas para garantir a acessibilidade de todos os nossos colaboradores, bem como dos candidatos do processo seletivo. Se você precisar de alguma adequação especial para participar do nosso processo seletivo, por favor, nos informe.

Principais áreas que recrutamos:

Essa é nosso banco de talentos de Diversidade, focado em Inclusão de Pessoas com Deficiência. Nosso time de Recrutamento está constantemente revisando os currículos que chegarem por aqui, e quando identificamos uma ótima oportunidade, entramos em contato com as pessoas para que elas participem do nosso processo de recrutamento.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Todas as pessoas com deficiência podem se inscrever nessa página e em qualquer outra vaga na nossa página de carreiras. Aqui, seu perfil será revisado e, se houver compatibilidade, encaminhado para áreas nas quais estamos contratando. Caso você não se identifique como uma pessoa com deficiência, confira nossas outras oportunidades na página de carreiras da VTEX.

  • Programa anual de participação nos lucros e elegibilidade para ações
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida com cobertura nacional fornecido pela VTEX
  • Programa de incentivo ao desenvolvimento de idiomas (Inglês, Espanhol, Português)
  • Vale-refeição flexível
  • Licenças parentais estendidas
  • Horário de trabalho flexível e cultura de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência financeira para montar sua estação de trabalho em casa
  • Frete grátis em mais de 1.000 lojas clientes da VTEX

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

Position Title

Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work

Appointment Type

Full-Time, Tenure-Track

Department

Social Work

Reports To

Dean, School of Social Work

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Teaching and Instruction

  • Teach graduate social work courses to include use of appropriate technologies
  • Use inclusive, student-centered instructional strategies
  • Participate in curriculum development and assessment
  • Mentor MSW and PhD students

Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda
  • Produce peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations
  • Pursue funding opportunities to support research and scholarship

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment
  • MSW from a CSWE-accredited program
  • Demonstrated ability or potential for effective teaching, research, and scholarship that aligns with the school’s needs, mission, vision, and guiding philosophy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online
  • At least two years post-MSW practice experience and social work licensure
  • Applicants for associate and full professor ranks must have a record of funded research

Application Process

For consideration, submit a letter of interest outlining research, teaching, service, and practice experiences along with a curriculum vita and two samples of scholarly work. Applications will be accepted until the positions are filled.

Compensation Range: $80,000 - $110,000

description:
Descrição da vaga

O CEL tem como missão proporcionar uma educação global de excelência, norteada por valores humanos, contribuindo para formar cidadãos íntegros e capazes de realizar as suas potencialidades.

Estamos buscando um Orientador Educacional protagonista para ajudar os alunos a se prepararem para o aproveitamento acadêmico, desenvolver o projeto de vida e competências pessoais ou sociais.

É importante que tenha o compromisso de assegurar os nossos três pilares (alta qualidade de ensino; educação do caráter e formação global) para todos os estudantes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Cabe à Orientação Educacional a implementação de projetos específicos junto aos alunos, de acordo com a demanda do cotidiano escolar. Tais projetos visam, primordialmente, ao sucesso acadêmico através de estímulo ao potencial de cada aluno, ao seu bem-estar social, à valorização de suas habilidades e aptidões e ao desenvolvimento de valores essenciais à realização de uma vida plena.
  • Participar da elaboração coletiva do Projeto Político‑Pedagógico do Estabelecimento;
  • Participar do planejamento de reuniões pedagógicas junto à Coordenação Geral e Direção Pedagógica;
  • Valorizar a autoestima dos alunos em geral, bem como estimular seu autoconhecimento;
  • Coordenar o processo de adaptação dos alunos a um novo segmento;
  • Planejar e participar, em conjunto com a Coordenação Geral, dos Conselhos de Classe;
  • Coordenar o processo de Orientação Profissional, visando à inserção dos alunos do Ensino Médio no mundo do trabalho;
  • Planejar, em conjunto com a Coordenação Geral, as reuniões com os pais/responsáveis;
  • Planejar e desenvolver o processo de eleição de alunos representantes de turma;
  • Realizar reuniões com os alunos representantes das turmas;
  • Desenvolver o trabalho de Coaching Educacional, proporcionando um autoconhecimento dos estudantes em relação ao seu desempenho acadêmico, estabelecendo‑se, durante o processo, metas junto aos alunos, visando superar dificuldades e/ou maximizar potencialidades;
  • Observar e zelar pelo cumprimento das leis em vigor e, em especial, pelos dados pessoais de todos os tomadores dos serviços educacionais, como descrito neste regimento;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes educacionais, referentes ao ensino inclusivo, descritas em normas emitidas pelos sistemas de ensino, assegurando e promovendo, em condições de igualdade, os direitos e liberdades fundamentais da pessoa com deficiência;
  • Incluir a promoção de medidas de conscientização, de prevenção e de combate a todos os tipos de violência, especialmente a intimidação sistemática (bullying) e o cyberbullying, de acordo com a lei vigente;
  • Fixar prestações alternativas à aplicação de provas e à frequência de aulas realizadas em dia de guarda religiosa, de acordo com a Lei vigente.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ao menos uma das seguintes formações:

  • Curso de Licenciatura Plena em Pedagogia;
  • Curso de pós‑graduação lato sensu em Supervisão ou Orientação Educacional/Escolar, com, no mínimo, 360 (trezentas e sessenta) horas, em instituição de educação superior credenciada e de acordo com as normas federais que tratam da matéria;

  • Licenciado em Nível Superior, habilitado em programa de formação em serviço ou extensão em Supervisão ou Orientação Educacional/Escolar, com no mínimo 120 (cento e vinte) horas, realizado em instituição de educação superior credenciada ou por meio de parceria com agência pública formadora.

Capacidade de agir com eficácia diante das necessidades de um grupo diversificado de alunos;

Descrição da vaga

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Garantir a execução da estratégia da nova plataforma de vídeos verticais da Globo, maximizando valor para usuários, anunciantes e produtores de conteúdo, por meio de decisões orientadas a dados, excelência em experiência e forte articulação com áreas especialistas;
  • Equilibrar crescimento de audiência, experiência do usuário, eficiência de monetização e otimização de custos em um ambiente de múltiplos stakeholders. Influenciar times especialistas que atuam em múltiplos produtos, sem gestão direta. Garantir clareza estratégica e velocidade de execução em produtos de alta exposição e relevância. Manter os produtos atualizados frente às rápidas transformações do mercado de entretenimento digital;
  • Executar a estratégia do produto sob a ótica de negócio, marca e experiência, garantindo coerência com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Ser responsável pelo desempenho financeiro, atuando junto às áreas comercial e financeira na identificação de oportunidades de monetização, eficiência de custo e otimização de margem;
  • Monitorar indicadores-chave da plataforma, identificando riscos, perdas de desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Atuar como especialista da experiência do produto, sendo referência nos fluxos de navegação, pontos de fricção, diferenciais competitivos e oportunidades de evolução;
  • Garantir o alinhamento do backlog de produto aos objetivos estratégicos do produto;
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de marca e posicionamento dos produtos, tanto para o público consumidor quanto para o mercado anunciante;
  • Acompanhar tendências de consumo de entretenimento digital, pesquisas de comportamento e movimentações de mercado;
  • Monitorar iniciativas de concorrentes e benchmarks, analisando resultados e propondo planos de resposta ou adaptação estratégica;
  • Gerir diretamente o times dedicado ao produto;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com os líderes de Tecnologia, Marketing, Conteúdo, Inteligência e Comercial;
  • Articular parcerias estratégicas que contribuam para crescimento, inovação e fortalecimento do produto.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência prévia com Produtos Digitais: buscamos alguém com experiência prévia de atuação direta em produtos digitais. Precisa ser uma pessoa com familiaridade com arquitetura de produto, priorização de backlog de desenvolvimento, mecânica de recomendação e arquitetura de dados;

  • Visão analítica, orientada a dados e centrada no usuário para tomada de decisão;
  • Compreensão de modelos de monetização de plataformas e produtos digitais, com foco em publicidade;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, priorização e comunicação com stakeholders.

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager works alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reports to the Head of Sustainability. The role is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services. As the Tournament draws closer, the role will evolve from planning into operations, resulting in an assignment to a competition or non‑competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to:
  • Ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including auditing official sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements and ensuring improvements are implemented.
  • Work with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Develop and deliver accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.

Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:

  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:

  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti‑Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • Deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • 5+ years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment and complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritisation and independent work.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools.

Additional Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations.
  • In‑depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega‑sporting events.
  • Experience developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience in sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Experience working in sports and/or events.
  • International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well‑organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship‑building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity to interact with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to the assigned Host City for the tournament operational period.

Atuar de forma plena nas análises dos processos operacionais inerentes ao setor de GRO, com o objetivo de manter níveis adequados à segurança ocupacional nos ambientes laborais, aos colaboradores de sua empresa, face a legislação vigente.

description:

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international humanitarian aid organization that provides assistance in more than 70 countries to populations in distress, to victims of natural or manmade disasters and to victims of armed conflicts, without discrimination and irrespective of origin, religion, creed or political affiliation.

CONTEXT

At the heart of the Operations Department in the Operational Centre of Brussels (OCB), the Cells are comprised of a multidisciplinary team of 7 people, including a Coordinator of Operations (CO), Deputy CO, Medical Officer, Human Resources Officer (HRO), Logistic Officer, Finance Officer, Supply Officer and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. Their role is to supervise and coordinate MSF activities in several countries. The Cells are the direct interface from HQ to international programmes. We are looking for a Finance Officer for Cell 5, based in Rio de Janeiro, managing the following countries: Haiti, Brazil, Venezuela and Dominican Republic.

As Finance Officer , you play a key strategic role in managing all finance‑and risk‑related domains. Embedded within the Operations Department and working closely with the Finance Department, you act as the Cell financial focal point, fully involved in operational decision‑making and familiar with all projects under the Cell’s portfolio.

As Finance Officer , you are responsible for the financial management of the programmes you oversee. This includes supporting, guiding, and coaching the Financial Coordinators (FinCos), ensuring the quality of management control, budgeting and forecasting, and risk resources management. You guarantee that financial analyses are accurate and aligned with MSF policies and processes. As a referent for FinCos, you promote optimal resource use and contribute to the organisation’s long‑term sustainability.

The countries assigned to the Cell are indicative, as a re‑shuffling of the portfolio within the operations department occurs on a regular basis.

The Finance Officer reports both to the Coordinator of Operations (line manager) and to the Operational Finance Coordinator (functional manager).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Strategy and Support

Ensure the long‑term sustainability of the finance and risk resources strategies applied in the programmes to complete the constraints related to the shorter‑term assignment for the Finance Coordinators.

Advise, support and challenge the Cell members and CO (Coordinator of Operations) in the management of the operational allocation of resources.

Centralize and lead the programme budget process in close collaboration with Cell members, acting as the guarantor of consistency across yearly and multi‑year budgets.

Collaborate actively in new project proposals, providing financial expertise throughout the process.

Monitor closely the economic indicators of each country and their consequences, ensure that appropriate measures are taken, and oversee their implementation with the Finance Coordinator.

Advise, challenge, and make final decisions on the analytical structure of the budget and accounting (cost centre, budget line, activity, referent), ensuring it is tailored to the strategic orientation, the need operational reporting, and fits the programme’s financial capacity and maturity.

Ensure the pertinence of the Finance team set‑up of the programmes, designing it in line with the operational context, needs and objectives, and adapt the Finance team set‑up according to the evolution of the context and the related risk assessment.

Internal/Quality Control, Standards and Compliance

Contribute actively to the development and upgrade of tools, finance standards, guidelines, and procedures as a key stakeholder.

Ensure that the financial tools, processes and guidelines are relevant, appropriate and are managed according to the MSF OCB standardin the programmes.

Ensure the Programme Finance Guideline is regularly updated and accurate to reflect local compliance requirements, regulation standards, and contextual realities in each programme.

Guide and motivate the Finance Coordinators, and influence the programme and the Cell on risk resource‑management, and compliance analysis as well as on mitigation measures.

Drive the implementation, analysis, and follow‑up of the recommendations of the Internal Control Tool for Finance processes.

Drive the implementation and follow up of internal, external, and national audit recommendations.

Resources Management

Oversee the budget management of the Cell’s portfolio.

Manage the coherence of the multi‑year budget with the project cycle and strategy.

Manage the accuracy of the initial budget by leading the ARO‑MYRO (Annual Review of Operations - Multi‑Year Review of Operation) financial process to its final validation.

Mentor the monthly forecast or quarterly monitoring meeting of projects and programmes by guiding and challenging the programmes in their calculation, projections and analyses.

Ensure the validation process for budget and forecast decision is respected.

Risk resources management of the Cell’s portfolio

Adapt and implement the standard insurance guidelines to the national and legal context.

Implement and regularly review the money security policy, ensuring it is adapted to the operational reality and programme constraints.

Develop and maintain awareness of the anti‑corruption policy and related reporting mechanisms, followed by appropriate measures to ensure compliance.

Ensure the efficiency of the process of programmes provision for litigations and the quality of the information.

Availability of funds in the mission to run the operations

Design and implement in close collaboration with the Finance Coordinators, the finance strategy related means of payment (innovative solutions, online banking, phone banking, hawallah, cash providers, virtual credit cards, etc.).

Review and validate the monthly cash request for the Cell portfolio.

Stakeholders Coordination - Internal and External Communication and Representation

Guarantee efficient communication and a close, effective collaboration with the Programme Accounting Controller overseeing programme accounting support.

Provide the needed information to the Funding Unit related to donor reporting.

Ensure compliance with national fiscal legislation, in collaboration with the ILD (International Legal Department) and other relevant technical departments.

Revise and influence programmes’ agreements involving other sections, procurement centres and international service providers.

Stimulate, maintain, and develop the finance component of intersectional collaboration; promote and uphold mutualisation and harmonisation between sections; and lead the resolution of issues related to finance interoperability among OCs.

Work in close collaboration with the partner section MSF Brazil (MSFBR), especially with its Finance Department, on accounting and tax‑related matters in Brazil, as the position is based in the country and the Cell supports operations locally.

People Management, Supervision and Development

Develop, collaborate on, and facilitate Finance trainings, webinars, and FinCo Weeks.

Anticipate and build the vision for developing key finance staff in programmes, taking into account the national context.

Coach, advise, and develop the competencies of the Financial Coordinators, and provide feedback in close collaboration with their line manager; steer the priority‑setting process in line with departmental strategy; monitor performance along the programme.

Enable a conducive environment within the finance department to foster good team dynamics.

Brief and debrief coordination members before and after their programme deployments.

Treasury Management for the Cell

Manage the Cell’s treasury, including the preparation and submission of the cash request through WeFin.

Oversee the approval of payments, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.

Manage the Cell’s bank account(s), ensuring proper liquidity levels, reconciliation, and alignment with MSF financial standards and procedures.

Budgeting and Forecasting

Coordinate actively with the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecasting activities, addressing queries related to expense variances and incurred costs at Cell level.

Serve as the primary contact for the HQ Controlling team on budget and forecast matters, regarding, ensuring timely and accurate responses to expense‑related inquiries.

Prepare the Cell’s annual budget in WeFin, in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

Produce and update the Cell’s forecast, ensuring realistic planning and alignment with operational priorities.

Monitor budget execution and provide financial analysis to ensure correct and compliant use of budget lines.

Accounting Follow Up

Monitor the Cell’s accounting, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies.

Support and monitor the accurate booking of all expenditures against the appropriate budget lines.

Ensure timely reporting and consolidation of financial information at the regional level.

REQUIREMENTS

University degree in management, business administration or finance (bachelor’s degree level) or equivalent professional experience.

Minimum 3 years of experience in finance management is mandatory , with MSF or another similar International Humanitarian Organisation (INGO).

Minimum 1 year of International MSF experience in different contexts and interventions , at least one experience as a Financial Coordinator is mandatory .

Advanced knowledge of Excel, Power BI, MS Office package.

Result‑oriented, with strong problem‑solving skills.

Planning and organising, can work under stress and capacity to prioritize.

Capacity to negotiate, with strong diplomacy and persuasive skills.

Effective in teamwork and collaboration, showing strong awareness of cross‑cultural dynamics.

Flexibility and adaptability.

Demonstrates creativity and innovation, with the capacity to take proactive initiatives.

Family position according to the MSF policy.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the development and delivery of key Sustainability Strategy initiatives to:

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023™ Sustainability Team:

  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

YOUR PROFILE

Minimum requirements:

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights;
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes;
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage:

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations;
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events;
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition;
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards;
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders;
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications;
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique knowledge and skills:

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe;
  • Self-motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate;
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written);
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills;
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds; and
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio-political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

description:
Why You're Here

You’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top‑of‑mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

Qualitative Metrics

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

  • Experience with LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data acquisition and system control.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, self‑motivation, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Previous experience in R&D environments is highly desirable.
  • Native portuguese and Fluent or Advanced English is required.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Valorizamos a candidatura de Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas negras, Pessoas LGBTI+, Pessoas 45+ e Mulheres!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável por executar e/ou monitorar o cumprimento de todos requisitos legais de segurança do trabalho aplicáveis à companhia (Ex: PGR, CIPA, Brigada de Emergência, etc.), visando o atendimento legal e a minimização/eliminação do impacto dos riscos à saúde das partes relacionadas.

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar a análise de acidentes ou quase acidentes, fornecendo diretrizes e metodologia de análise para determinar as causas dos mesmos, visando o bloqueio e/ou neutralização através de propostas de medidas de controle;
  • Prestar apoio técnico às áreas, sempre com foco no atendimento legal e na segurança e integridade física dos envolvidos;
  • Realizar e participar de inspeções dos mais diversos temas relacionados à segurança;
  • Realizar e participar de auditorias de certificação bem como de averiguações internas;
  • Controlar e reportar os indicadores das regiões de sua responsabilidade;
  • Aplicar treinamentos, sempre que necessário;
  • Desenvolver e implementar procedimentos de gestão de segurança do trabalho;
  • Participar ativamente da concepção e do evento da SIPAT (Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalho);
  • Atuar na avaliação do cumprimento dos requisitos legais dos contratados e subcontratados, inclusive de suas liberações para execução das atividades, bem como controlar a ocorrência de acidentes ou quase acidentes dos mesmos;
  • Promover a realização anual dos simulados de emergência das edificações das regiões que fiquem sob a sua responsabilidade, conforme PAE (Programa de Atendimento à Emergências) também construído internamente pelo profissional, com suporte dos engenheiros de segurança do trabalho;
  • Compor, manter e acompanhar de perto a atuação das CIPAs (Comissões Internas de Prevenção de Acidentes).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Desejada: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
  • Sólida experiência na área
  • Experiência atuando em grandes empresas e, preferencialmente com grande capilaridade nacional;
  • Experiência de campo e em desenvolvimento ou implementação de processos e indicadores de gestão; Experiência em processos de emergência, principalmente relacionados à proteção e combate a incêndios.
  • Fundamentos de ESG.

Informações adicionais

Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

Benefícios

  • Programa de Benefícios Flexíveis
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica *
  • Benefício Medicamentos *
  • Wellhub (ex-Gympass) *
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição
  • Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro
  • Previdência Privada
  • Aparelho celular com Internet Ilimitada e franquia de Voz
  • Convênios e Parcerias com mais de 3.000 empresas e instituições, incluindo parcerias para desconto na sua conta de luz e internet banda larga
  • Curso de inglês online extensível a 1 familiar ou amigo
  • Programa de Treinamento e Capacitação Internos
  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Meu primeiro benefício - Auxílio para filhos até 2 anos de idade
  • Reembolso Creche (para pais ou mães)
  • Modelos de trabalho e jornada flexíveis
  • Happy Day - Dia de folga no mês do aniversário
  • Licenças estendidas para maternidade, paternidade, casamento e adoção

E outros!

title: TECNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO - SMS
description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
