title: Site Leader, Sub Same Day
description:
Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as a Site Leader. In this role, you will play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location. You will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer. We are a combination of operations and support teams covering aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities

  • Support, mentor, and motivate your team
  • Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact
  • Create and implement productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
  • Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
  • Collaborate with all support teams including (but not limited to) Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and PXT to develop plans to meet business objectives
  • Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
  • Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
  • Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
  • Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
  • Experience in managing teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Experiência Publicitária e Insights de Jornada | Globoplay
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a área:

Somos o streaming com maior tempo de consumo dos brasileiros, e não é à toa! O brasileiro se vê por aqui, e nós cuidamos com carinho de cada usuário que escolhe consumir os conteúdos do Globoplay.

No time de Experiência Publicitária Globoplay, temos uma missão dupla e essencial: garantimos que a publicidade seja relevante e integrada à experiência, ao mesmo tempo em que atuamos como os guardiões da Voz do Usuário . Nosso objetivo é equilibrar as metas de negócio com uma jornada fluida, prazerosa e de alta qualidade para quem nos assiste.

Diversidade :

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro, RJ ou São Paulo, SP.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Liderar a estratégia de "Voz do Usuário" (VoC): Coletar, analisar e transformar feedbacks de usuários em insights acionáveis para o produto como um todo, garantindo que as dores dos consumidores sejam ouvidas e priorizadas.
  • Mapear fricções e oportunidades: Olhar para a jornada completa do usuário no Globoplay, identificando pontos críticos tanto na navegação geral quanto na exposição publicitária.
  • Equilibrar Experiência e Monetização: Traduzir insumos estratégicos em planos de ação que melhorem a experiência ponta a ponta, garantindo que novos formatos publicitários não gerem churn ou impacto negativo na percepção da marca.
  • Execução e Integração: Acompanhar iniciativas de experiência, garantindo consistência entre os diferentes formatos, canais e momentos da jornada do cliente.
  • Governança de Insights: Organizar rituais de acompanhamento e levar a "visão do usuário" para mesas de decisão, sustentando a execução de frentes estratégicas com base em dados reais.
  • Benchmarking e Inteligência: Gerar insumos competitivos por meio de pesquisas e análise de mercado para subsidiar decisões sobre modelos de experiência que encantem o usuário.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, UX ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com Programas de Voz do Usuário (VoC) ou Customer Experience (CX): Expertise em metodologias de escuta e análise de sentimento do cliente;
  • Perfil analítico e investigativo: Facilidade para conectar dados quantitativos (KPIs) com qualitativos (o que o usuário diz);
  • Habilidade de influência: Capacidade de ser o advogado do usuário perante times de tecnologia, produto e comercial;
  • Gestão de Projetos/Processos: Experiência em organizar fluxos de trabalho que envolvam múltiplos stakeholders.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Experiência com plataformas de streaming ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Domínio de métricas de satisfação (NPS, CSAT, CES ) e retenção;
  • Conhecimento em Jornada do Cliente e Service Design;
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de publicidade digital;
  • Capacidade de síntese para apresentações executivas (contar histórias através dos dados dos usuários).

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Turnaround Engineer to join Maintenance Solution Department (MSD) under Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME). MSD is responsible for providing specialized and timely maintenance engineering support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities. Your primary role is to provide turnaround management services for refining and petrochemical plants of Saudi Aramco (SA) downstream sector. The services will cover the coordination with SA wholly owned assets, affiliates, affiliates management, OSPAS and other related corporate functions such as Corporate Maintenance Services Department.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist/Lead turnaround assurance review or cold-eye review of turnaround preparation of different facilities in order to have predictable outcome and improvement.
  • Review the progress and quality of the deliverables during the turnaround life cycle and all the phases and provide convincing recommendations for improvements.
  • Work as an influencer and motivate turnaround planning team of different facilities to implement best practices, lessons learned to enhance quality, safety as well as competitiveness.
  • Review implementation of stage-gated turnaround processes in different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct risk management workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct scope challenge workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/conduct schedule challenge workshop for turnarounds for different facilities.
  • Assist/review Key Performance Indicators for turnarounds.
  • Keep abreast of significant developments in new technologies which can improve turnaround performances.
  • Lead and run Community of Practice to collect and disseminate the best practices and knowledge between all refining and petrochemical assets.

Qualifications

  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 12 years experience in Turnaround Management including planning & execution in the Oil & Gas Downstream sector (Refining & Petrochemicals).
  • You will have experience in turnaround planning software such as Prometheus, ROSER, Primavera P6 and any other end-to-end solutions for turnaround and outage management.
  • You will have thorough knowledge and experience in turnaround stage gated concept.
  • Experience in conducting turnaround assurance is preferred.
  • You must have good understanding of competitiveness, and Solomon indices pertaining to turnaround performance.
  • SAP system proficiency is required.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.

title: Training Supervisor
description:
United Nations – Inclusive Employer The job is with United Nations, a globally inclusive organization and a member of myGwork, the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community.

Job Summary

The Training Supervisor reports to the Head of the Brazil Office and supports the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio project by mobilizing the city of Petrópolis and its citizens towards non-structural actions to reduce disaster risks, conducting training programs, and monitoring progress.

Work Location

Petrópolis, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Expected Duration

6 months, with possibility of renewal.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Plan and implement training programs aligned with project needs and objectives.
  • Supervise the training of monitors, ensuring proper preparation for specific tasks.
  • Monitor participants' progress, evaluating content absorption and skill development.
  • Create or review training materials, adapting them to local realities and team profiles.
  • Incorporate innovative and dynamic methodologies to maximize engagement and learning effectiveness.
  • Conduct periodic team assessments to check the practical application of acquired knowledge.
  • Identify skill gaps and propose additional training.
  • Suggest improvements to training processes based on team feedback and observed results.
  • Produce detailed training reports, including results, challenges and recommendations for implementation.
  • Track performance indicators related to training, such as attendance, engagement and team results of impact.
  • Promote a positive and motivating learning environment during training.
  • Produce monthly reports on personal work activities.
  • Perform other duties requested by the supervisor.
  • Participate in missions as requested.
  • Complete all courses and training activities indicated by the supervisor, including the BSAFE security course within the first month of employment.
  • Familiarize with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Disaster Risk Management and Resilience Geospatial Science, Urban Planning, Public Management or related fields, or three (3) years of relevant experience.
  • Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Training and Development, Project Management, or related fields is desirable.
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in planning and executing training programs, preferably in community or educational projects in Brazil.
  • Experience supervising operational teams.
  • Experience holding leadership roles in post‑disaster contexts is desirable.
  • Previous experience within the UN System is desirable.

Skills and Competencies

  • Good computer skills in the Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and mastery of technological tools and online platforms.
  • Good knowledge of training methodologies in the environmental sector.
  • Professionalism: experience in inter‑institutional environments, project management and monitoring‑evaluation.
  • Planning and organization: strong responsibility, able to work with minimal supervision and manage workloads efficiently.
  • Communication: ability to write clearly, listen, interpret messages and respond appropriately; ability to write for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: leadership, conflict management, consensus facilitation, respectful of diversity and vulnerable groups; willingness to work in difficult environments.
  • Knowledge Management: familiarity with UN‑Habitat processes and procedures; propose and maintain efficient formats and procedures; ensure proper maintenance of relevant documentation.

Languages

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required.
  • Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.
  • English and French are working languages of the United Nations Secretariat; Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.

Travel

The consultant must be available to travel within Brazil as requested by the Head of Brazil Office for mission‑related activities, which will be coordinated and financed by UN‑Habitat according to United Nations travel rules and guidelines.

The field will be developed with 12 subsea wells tied back to a new building Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) unit. The FPSO will be in water depths of 2000m, roughly 200km south of Rio de Janeiro.While Shell is a major producer in Brazil, Orca is critical to extend Shell-operated production into the 2030s. The project will leverage the experience of the FPSO Contractor to supply and operate the FPSO. The FPSO Contractor is one of the foremost suppliers of FPSOs in the world and currently operates more than a dozen FPSOs in Brazil. The FPSO Contractor Detailed Engineering, Procurement and Project Management is centered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, while construction is spread across multiple construction yards in China and Japan, while Installation and Commissioning will be performed offshore Brazil.Orca contracting is focused on the selection of Tier 1 Contractors to maximize delivery confidence for the FPSO, Subsea Hardware (SSHW) and Umbilical Riser & Flowline (URF) contracts. The project employs a lean Owner’s Team with the delivery know-how and commercial acumen to effectively balance “letting the contractor deliver in an area where they are experts” while maintaining expert oversight over critical delivery components of the project to deliver a world class operating asset safely, on time and on budget. Hence, team members must demonstrate the ability to build strong, collaborative relationships with Contractors; to implement scaled assurance processes to manage design and execution risks in a pragmatic way; to adapt Shell processes to industry driven solutions while maintaining system integrity and performance; and to work across system and discipline boundaries for best for project solutions.Accountabilities:* Develop and maintain integrated project schedules across all project phases (initiation to execution and closeout), ensuring alignment with project objectives, stakeholder expectations and contractual milestones.* Lead schedule planning sessions (WBS, activities, logic, durations, critical path) and ensure accurate input from engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and support functions.* Perform critical path and scenario analysis, identifying schedule risks, opportunities and mitigation strategies.* Produce periodic progress reports including schedule performance metrics, forecasts, slippage analysis and KPIs (e.g., SPI, milestone performance).* Ensure planning governance, adhering to corporate project controls standards, processes, templates, and reporting requirements.* Interface with contractors and suppliers, validating their schedules, progress updates and compliance with planning requirements.* Support change management, assessing schedule impacts of change requests, scope variations and risk events.* Drive continuous improvement, enhancing planning tools, methods and project controls maturity.* Interface with project disciplines & contractors to ensure the schedule is fully integrated.**What you bring*** Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management or a related field* 10+ years of experience in planning/scheduling within complex capital projects, acquired preferably in major oil & gas offshore installation projects* Proven experience in EPCI/EPC, industrial, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure or similar environments* Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (mandatory) and MS Project* Strong understanding of project controls principles, including:* Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) development* Critical Path Method (CPM)* Progress measurement systems* Earned Value Management (EVM)* Ability to read and interpret engineering documents, procurement plans and construction sequences* Experience with data analytics and reporting tools* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities.* Strong analytical mindset and high attention to detail.* Ability to influence without authority and facilitate cross-functional alignment.* Proactive, adaptable and oriented to solutions.**What we offer**You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.**We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,** **.****Shell in Brazil****Who We Are**Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 85,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.**Our approach**Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net-zero emissions business by 2050.As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.**Our values**At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.-**DISCLAIMER:**Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. description:
Descrição da vaga

Você é uma pessoa motivada, com vontade de crescer e construir uma carreira sólida? Busca um ambiente onde seu trabalho é valorizado e seu desenvolvimento profissional é uma prioridade? Então, temos a oportunidade perfeita para você!

Em nossa empresa, valorizamos a dedicação, o comprometimento e o desejo de fazer a diferença. Como vigilante, você não estará apenas protegendo patrimônios; estará também zelando pela segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e visitantes. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a ordem e a tranquilidade, tornando o ambiente mais seguro para todos.

Em nossa empresa oferecemos, investimos no crescimento dos nossos colaboradores com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira.

Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade.

Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante!

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e contar com seu talento em nossa equipe.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a segurança e a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e dos visitantes, monitorando e prevenindo atividades suspeitas ou ilegais, assegurando a ordem e o cumprimento das normas internas.

  • Realizar rondas periódicas nas instalações para prevenir e detectar sinais de intrusão, roubo, vandalismo ou outras atividades ilegais.
  • Controlar e registrar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos e materiais nas dependências dos clientes.
  • Controlar a entrada de visitantes e prestadores de serviços, garantindo que estejam devidamente cadastrados e acompanhados.
  • Identificar e relatar situações de risco ou condições inseguras, tomando ações preventivas para evitar acidentes ou incidentes.
  • Atuar de forma rápida e eficiente em situações de contingência, como incêndios, acidentes ou invasões, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Colaborar com as forças de segurança pública em casos de crimes ou distúrbios.
  • Manter registros precisos de atividades diárias, incidentes, ocorrências e outras informações relevantes.
  • Preencher relatórios de ocorrência e comunicar aos superiores sobre quaisquer incidentes significativos.
  • Oferecer atendimento cordial e profissional aos colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, fornecendo informações e orientações quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na organização e controle de eventos internos.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso de formação de vigilante com reciclagem em dia.
  • Experiência prévia na área de segurança patrimonial ou funções similares.
  • Conhecimento básico em informática e sistemas de vigilância eletrônica.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em turnos, incluindo noites, fins de semana e feriados.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações de stress e tomar decisões rápidas.

title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including Regional Main, Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter-Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor, evaluate, and record training activities and program effectiveness. Set up and coordinate HIV-related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals, guides, and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in-person or online meetings, and training events. Present information using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos, and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize, and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishments. Monitor training costs to ensure the budget is not exceeded, prepare budget reports to justify expenditures, and select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed, identify training needs, and effectively reach the targeted audience and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community-based organizations, professional schools, and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining, and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet Program Quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training, and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community-based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on project outcomes and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities into the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers and related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access).
  • Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students, and the general public. Knowledge of creating and managing contracts for vendors, data entry, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently to assist in paperwork for processing of grant funds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in business or administration and 3-6 years of experience. Five years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$42,000-52,000

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products).

2026's vision and (how this role contributes)

In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance .

Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that:

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU),
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue,
  • Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one‑click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.

Challenges and opportunities (what you’ll own)

  • World‑class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first‑layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real‑time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low‑latency ads decisioning and NuPay real‑time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One‑click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one‑click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One‑Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost‑effective infra.

What you’ll find in the team

  • High‑calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high‑impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real‑time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi‑partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.

What you’ll navigate

  • Heavy cross‑BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re‑architecture or open‑scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third‑party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade‑offs between accelerating one‑stack migration and accepting short‑term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?:

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols

  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort-level experiment tracking

  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How we work:

  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

World-Class Benefits:

  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada)
  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Interview process

Do you believe you're a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We'd love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

Please refrain from messaging or emailing people directly, if you are interested, apply directly, your application will be reviewed by a human.

  1. Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  2. First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be a exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P - Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion about leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  4. Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands-on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  5. Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C - Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess tradeoffs, and growth related product work.
  6. Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus's strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

description:
Coordenador(a) de Riscos Cibernéticos – Globo – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Compreender como os diferentes riscos cibernéticos podem afetar as operações da Globo, priorizando os esforços para proteger os aspectos mais vitais do negócio e minimizar possíveis interrupções, violações de dados, não conformidade, penalidades financeiras ou impactos na marca e/ou reputação;
  • Avaliar o impacto potencial dos riscos de segurança cibernética nos processos e funções críticas do negócio;
  • Avaliar a relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação as possíveis perdas, ponderando as despesas com a implementação de controles de segurança em relação ao impacto financeiro e operacional de um incidente de segurança, otimizando a alocação de recursos para alcançar a máxima eficiência na redução de risco;
  • Alinhar a gestão de riscos cibernéticos com os objetivos do negócio, compreendendo os objetivos estratégicos e garantindo que as medidas de segurança cibernética sejam integradas de forma harmoniosa;
  • Coordenar a identificação e classificação dos riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e os impactos desses riscos;
  • Coordenar a coleta de dados de avaliação de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros e realizar avaliações de riscos de segurança cibernética para terceiros críticos, conforme necessário;
  • Implementar e evoluir com o sistema de monitoramento e gerenciamento de riscos de segurança cibernética de terceiros, conforme definido nos contratos com terceiros e de acordo com Política de Segurança da Informação para Fornecedores;
  • Construir planos de remediação, colaborando com as demais lideranças da empresa para alcançar um equilíbrio entre os requisitos de segurança e a necessidade de agilidade, inovação e crescimento do negócio, assegurando que as ferramentas de segurança ou outros controles compensatórios sugeridos reduzam o risco identificado para um nível aceitável;
  • Fornecer treinamento/orientação às partes interessadas em toda a Globo para promover uma forte cultura de conscientização sobre riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Bacharelado em: Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em auditoria de TI, gestão de riscos corporativos (ERM) ou gestão de riscos cibernéticos;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em identificar e avaliar riscos para os negócios da organização, estruturas de gestão de riscos e estruturas de gestão de segurança da informação, com foco na priorização de esforços para proteger aspectos vitais e minimizar interrupções;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos dos padrões de segurança cibernética, incluindo, mas não se limitando ISO 27005, OpenFAIR, NIST RMF, IRAM, TOGAF, NIST CSF e ISO/IEC 27001;
  • Histórico comprovado na realização de Análises de Custo-Benefício de Medidas de Segurança, incluindo a avaliação da relação custo-benefício das medidas de segurança cibernética em relação a potenciais perdas comerciais;
  • Experiência com princípios e práticas de segurança cibernética, incluindo gerenciamento de riscos, controles de segurança e continuidade de negócios, entre eles a ISO 22301, Práticas Profissionais do Disaster Recovery Institute (DRI) e a elaboração de Análise de Impacto no Negócio (BIA);
  • Experiência comprovada na integração da gestão de riscos de segurança cibernética com a estratégia geral de negócios, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Experiência com auditorias de conformidade, segurança e planos de mitigação de riscos;
  • Amplo conhecimento dos conceitos de gestão de riscos e governança de segurança cibernética de terceiros;
  • Experiência na avaliação de riscos de terceiros, condução e resposta a procedimentos de due dilligence e na criação de questionários para avaliação de riscos cibernético de terceiros para terceiros empresariais;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar efetivamente os outros, modificando opiniões, planos ou comportamentos de forma estruturada e eficiente com base nos dados e fatos analisados;
  • Domínio de técnicas de apresentação, possibilitando a construção de narrativas e histórias através de apresentações;
  • Experiência em influenciar terceiros e gerenciar relacionamentos com terceiros;
  • Conhecimento de métodos analíticos e proficiência em análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias e ferramentas (por exemplo: serviços de classificação financeira, serviços de classificação de segurança, plataformas integradas de gerenciamento de risco, plataformas de gerenciamento de risco de terceiros, etc.) que auxiliarão na avaliação do risco financeiro e operacional associado a fornecedores atuais e potenciais.

Conhecimentos que te destacam

  • Certificações de gestão de riscos e segurança da informação como: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), Certified in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA) ou Open FAIR Part-1.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

  • Negociar e aprovar, conforme alçada definida, atendimentos particulares para o cumprimento das garantias de atendimento exigidas pela ANS e alinhamento às diretrizes regulatórias e de governança da Empresa.

  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de indicadores de cálculos;

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS e outras soluções corporativas.
  • Investigar alertas e incidentes, conduzindo análises profundas (deep dive) e propondo ações de contenção, erradicação e recuperação.
  • Correlacionar eventos entre múltiplas ferramentas de segurança (SIEM, EDR, DLP, Firewall, Cloud Security, entre outros).

  • Colaborar na melhoria contínua dos processos de monitoramento, governança de alertas e ajustes de regras em ferramentas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, TTPs e ferramentas de ataque, sugerindo melhorias no ambiente.
  • Auxiliar na implementação e manutenção de ferramentas de segurança e projetos relacionados ao SOC.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prática em ambientes de SOC, com ferramentas como SIEM, EDR e IDS/IPS e Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e CIS.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação ou atuação em SOC/NOC.
  • Conhecimento sólido em análise de logs, tráfego de rede, protocolos (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS etc.) e investigação de incidentes.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, Elastic etc.), EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint etc.), IDS/IPS, WAF, DLP e soluções de Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança e metodologias como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS Controls.
  • Conhecimento em redes, criptografia, proxies, firewalls e operações de segurança.
  • Boa comunicação para interação entre áreas e produção de relatórios técnicos/executivos.

title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development.

You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To succeed in this role, you typically have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

title: Human Rights Manager
description:
Department

Social Responsibility & Education

Location

Brazil

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone.
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms.
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities.
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.
  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes.
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

  6. Aplicar técnicas de visualização de dados e de estatística para análise preliminar (pré-processamento) das diversas e volumosas bases de dados, estruturados ou não estruturados, candidatas a fonte de dados para os algoritmos de Machine Learning/Deep Learning/Otimização;
  7. Desenvolver melhorias constantes das técnicas aplicadas aos modelos preditivos e prescritivos, incluindo planejar e elaborar novos relatórios e relatórios customizados às necessidades dos clientes das áreas de negócio;

  9. Realizar apresentações orais, para os níveis operacional e executivo, sobre os projetos, análises e estudos sob sua responsabilidade;
  10. Reportar, periodicamente a seus superiores, o andamento das atividades e dos produtos;
  11. Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade, como por exemplo, análises descritivas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Economia, Matemática ou correlatas;
  2. Conhecimento e experiência comprovada em métodos, técnicas, e algoritmos de Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e LLMs;
  3. Conhecimento e experiência comprovada em métodos estatísticos de apoio à decisão: probabilidade e inferência estatística; assim como, nos fundamentos específicos de processos estocásticos, inferência, teoria da probabilidade, estatística multivariada, modelagens em geral, conhecimento de teoria de filas entre outros;
  4. Capacidade de interpretar os resultados e avaliar a adequação teórica das soluções desenvolvidas, gerando informações confiáveis e com embasamento teórico para tomada de decisão;
  5. Estar atento para identificar oportunidades de negócio através dos dados e propor novas soluções;
  6. Experiência comprovada em algumas das ferramentas a seguir: preferencialmente Phyton; R; SQL; Computação em Nuvem, preferência em Microsoft Azure (Databricks e Azure Machine Learning);
  7. Conhecimento e experiência comprovada em metodologias ágeis;
  8. Habilidade na comunicação de conceitos analíticos complexos para pessoas de outras áreas de atuação;
  9. Capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita, e de condução de sessões conjuntas de levantamento de necessidades junto às áreas de negócio;
  10. Inglês

description:
Job type: Full-time employee

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem, no setor de Nefrologia/Hemodiálise, e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Realizar orientações aos pacientes;
  • Manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis;
  • Orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;
  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e equipe multiprofissional;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;
  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Qualificações e Condições

  • Nível superior completo em enfermagem.
  • Registro ativo e regular com anuidade paga no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN-RJ).
  • Comprovação, por meio de certificado, de especialização na área de atuação.
  • Comprovação de, no mínimo, 6 meses de experiência atuando como enfermeiro na área de atuação (Hemodiálise).
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x60 ainda a serem definidas.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Digital Marketing Manager

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Head of Digital Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Senior Digital Marketing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Digital Marketing team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for managing, planning and delivering digital marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developing, implementing, and managing multi-channel digital marketing strategies that align with business, tournament and marketing and communication objectives, ensuring integration across owned digital channels (website, social media, CRM and mobile apps).
  • Coordinating with FIFA’s global digital marketing team to ensure alignment of local campaigns with overall strategies and objectives.
  • Collaborating with tournament stakeholders, including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees to amplify digital campaigns.
  • Leading alignment with internal functional areas and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive marketing strategies, providing clear communication and expectations across all parties involved.
  • Overseeing the creation, curation, and distribution of engaging digital content that resonates with local and global audiences in support of marketing activity.
  • Ensuring all digital content follows FIFA Women’s World Cup brand guidelines and maintains a consistent tone of voice.
  • Monitoring and analysing the performance of digital campaigns using various analytics tools.
  • Providing regular reports and insights to the global team and other stakeholders.
  • Optimising campaigns based on data-driven insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Acting as the primary digital marketing liaison between the Zurich-based global team and the Brazilian-based local tournament and event teams.
  • Maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration.
  • Supporting Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners and Media Partners with tailored digital marketing strategies to enhance local engagement.
  • Staying up to date with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies.

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education.

Work Experience

  • Proven experience (5-7 years) in managing large-scale digital marketing campaigns, preferably in sports or entertainment and in the South American market.

Additional Skills

  • Digital Platform Expertise: Strong understanding of social media platforms and trends, mobile app marketing, as well as web content and email marketing
  • Strategic Thinking: Capacity to think long-term and align marketing efforts with overall business objectives
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely execution and delivery
  • Technical & Proficiency Skills: Proficiency in using digital marketing and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, SEO Tools, CRM Software, Social Media analytics platforms such as Sprinklr) to interpret data, analyse metrics and make data‑driving decisions
  • SEO/SEM Knowledge: Understanding of search engine optimisation and search engine marketing techniques
  • Problem‑Solving: Proactive approach to identifying challenges and finding solutions in a fast‑paced environment
  • Result‑Oriented: Focusing on achieving measurable outcomes and meeting organisational goals
  • Decision Making: Quick to identify issues and make swift decisions in critical situations, taking initiative and assessing risks effectively
  • Strong Communication Skills: Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
  • Fan/Customer‑Centric Mindset: Skilled at understanding fan/customer needs and tailoring marketing strategies accordingly
  • Budget Management: Experience in managing budgets and allocating resources effectively
  • Market Knowledge: Knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture and trends

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
Cargo

Analista CX / CS Pleno

Descrição

Mapear e compreender a jornada do cliente (do onboarding ao pós‑venda), construindo Mapa da Jornada do Cliente e Mapa de serviço (Blueprint) para identificar fricções, pontos de abandono e oportunidades de melhoria por área.

Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas de satisfação e esforço (ex.: NPS, CSAT, CES). Consolidar insights e apresentar relatórios executivos com recomendações priorizadas por impacto e esforço.

Monitorar indicadores de sucesso do cliente (ex.: churn, expansão, engajamento, tempo de resolução, FCR, tempo de resposta, adoção de features, health score) em Power BI, construindo dashboards e narrativas visuais para tomada de decisão.

Realizar análise de processos ponta a ponta (descoberta, desenho e melhoria contínua) aplicando PDCA, Lean, Kaizen e DMAIC (Lean Six Sigma); conduzir workshops de ideação com Design Thinking e priorização via Matriz Impacto x Esforço.

Conduzir diagnósticos de canais de atendimento (chat, e‑mail, telefone, app, web), avaliando tempo de resposta, qualidade, taxa de solução, sentimento e voz do cliente (VoC).

Estruturar e manter o backlog de melhorias de CX/CS, fazendo a interface com TI, Produto e Áreas de Negócio; aplicar Scrum/Kanban para planejamento de sprints, definição de épicos, histórias e critérios de aceite.

Apoiar e facilitar comitês de experiência e sucesso com toda a gerência: preparar materiais executivos (PowerPoint/Power BI), storytelling dos achados, plano de ação e seguimento das iniciativas; registrar decisões e responsáveis.

Desenvolver e validar hipóteses por meio de testes A/B, provas de conceito e pilotos; mensurar resultados, documentar aprendizados e escalar soluções.

Interface com a área de curadoria de conteúdos e fluxos de atendimento (base de conhecimento, FAQs, chatbots/URA), alinhando tom de voz e diretrizes de comunicação; promover autossuficiência e redução de esforço do cliente.

Atuar como guardião da visão centrada no cliente, influenciando stakeholders, promovendo rituais de CX/CS (Daily/Review/Retrospectiva) e acompanhando a execução até a entrega dos resultados.

description:
Sobre a Vaga


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner com perfil estratégico e relacional para liderar a evolução de produtos e soluções voltadas para o segmento de órgãos institucionais, com foco especial em demandas técnicas do DETRAN. O PO será responsável por traduzir necessidades complexas do cliente em requisitos claros, gerenciar o backlog de produto e garantir a entrega de valor contínuo.


A posição combina análise técnica profunda, relacionamento estratégico com stakeholders (DETRAN, despachantes, entidades e parceiros público-privado) e gestão ágil de produto, com atuação tanto remota quanto em campo para melhor compreensão das demandas.


Principais responsabilidades



  • Elicitar, analisar e documentar requisitos técnicos e funcionais, especialmente de demandas complexas do DETRAN e órgãos institucionais.

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de produto, alinhando com objetivos estratégicos e necessidades do cliente.

  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas (desenvolvimento, arquitetura) e stakeholders (DETRAN, clientes, parceiros), garantindo alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Conduzir reuniões de refinamento, validação e aceite de requisitos com foco em clareza e viabilidade técnica.

  • Acompanhar e validar entregas, garantindo conformidade com requisitos e padrões de qualidade.

  • Participar ativamente em campo, com visitas a clientes e órgãos para melhor compreensão do contexto operacional e demandas técnicas.

  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com DETRAN e demais stakeholders, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

  • Preparar e acompanhar indicadores de produto (ex.: adoção, satisfação, impacto técnico, ROI).

  • Participar de reuniões internas e alinhar ações com áreas envolvidas (desenvolvimento, operações, comercial, suporte).

  • Documentar decisões, trade-offs e aprendizados para manutenção de histórico e conhecimento institucional.


Requisitos



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em papel similar (mínimo 2-3 anos).

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro ou similar).

  • Forte capacidade de análise técnica e compreensão de arquitetura de software, APIs e integrações.

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes institucionais, órgãos públicos ou ambientes regulados é um diferencial.

  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e capacidade de conduzir conversas complexas com diferentes perfis técnicos e não-técnicos.

  • Organização para documentação, rastreamento de requisitos e gestão de prioridades.

  • Conforto com rotina híbrida: remoto + campo (visitas e agendas presenciais).

  • Conhecimento em domínios como DETRAN, trânsito, licitações ou parcerias público-privada é um diferencial.


Desejável



  • Conhecimento estruturado em governança de TI baseado em COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies), incluindo governança e gestão orientada a valor, gestão de riscos, compliance, controles e alinhamento estratégico entre negócio e tecnologia.

  • Domínio prático de frameworks ágeis, especialmente Scrum, incluindo gestão de backlog, sprint planning, review, retrospectiva, escrita de user stories, critérios de aceite e priorização por valor.

  • Conhecimento ou certificação em PMP (Project Management Professional), com entendimento do ecossistema de gestão de projetos, incluindo PMBOK, gestão de escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, riscos e stakeholders.

  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes híbridos de gestão (ágil + tradicional), conectando produto, projeto e governança.

  • Conhecimento complementar desejável: ITIL, Lean, Lean Inception, Design Thinking, Product Discovery e Delivery, OKRs e métricas de produto.
